full_text_en:
Guiding Case No. 254

Xiamen Mou Health Management Co., Ltd. v. Fujian Mou Sports Industry Co., Ltd. — implementation case on property preservation deduction

(Adopted by the Judicial Committee of the Supreme People's Court and released on April 7, 2025)

Keywords enforcement; property preservation deduction implementation; automatic performance; trial-execution coordination

Key Points of Enforcement Implementation

After a judgment becomes effective and before a case is filed for enforcement, the preserved party may apply to the people's court for deduction of its preserved funds to fulfill obligations determined by the effective judgment. If there is no circumstance that may harm the lawful rights and interests of other creditors, the people's court may render a ruling on deduction; if the debt is fully satisfied through the above procedure, the people's court may issue a certificate of automatic performance to the preserved party.

Basic Facts

In the lease contract dispute case between Xiamen Mou Health Management Co., Ltd. (hereinafter "Xiamen Mou Health Company") and Fujian Mou Sports Industry Co., Ltd. (hereinafter "Fujian Mou Sports Company"), the Haicang District People's Court of Xiamen, Fujian Province, upon the application of Xiamen Mou Health Company, rendered a ruling on July 24, 2024, preserving the property of Fujian Mou Sports Company valued at over RMB 270,000 (the same currency below), of which over RMB 190,000 was funds in bank accounts. On October 24, 2024, under the auspices of the people's court, the parties reached a mediation agreement: Fujian Mou Sports Company was to pay RMB 75,000 to Xiamen Mou Health Company. Subsequently, Fujian Mou Sports Company submitted a written application, expressing its willingness to voluntarily perform the payment obligation determined in the mediation agreement, and on the grounds that the funds in the preservation account were sufficient to satisfy the debt and that it had no other working capital, requested the people's court to directly deduct funds from its preservation account to settle the debt involved. Xiamen Mou Health Company had no objection to this method of performance.

Upon investigation, Fujian Mou Sports Company had no other pending litigation or enforcement cases, and its application for preservation deduction did not involve any circumstance that might harm the lawful rights and interests of other creditors.

The Haicang District People's Court lawfully granted the application of Fujian Mou Sports Company and rendered a ruling on deduction, which specified the implementation of property preservation in this case, the content and time limit for performance under the mediation agreement, the parties' application, and the funds already controlled in the preservation account.

Judgment

On October 24, 2024, the Haicang District People's Court rendered Civil Ruling No. 4139, First Instance (2024), Min 0205, ordering the transfer and withdrawal of a total of RMB 75,000 from the preserved bank account under the name of Fujian Mou Sports Company. On October 29, 2024, the Haicang District People's Court implemented the deduction from the preserved account of Fujian Mou Sports Company through the preservation enforcement case, distributed the full amount to Xiamen Mou Health Company, and issued a "Certificate of Automatic Performance" to Fujian Mou Sports Company.

Reasoning

With respect to preserved funds, the people's court may, after rendering an effective judgment but before filing a case for enforcement, lawfully make a ruling on deduction of such funds (hereinafter referred to as "pre-enforcement preservation deduction measure"). This measure enables the creditor to realize its claim as soon as possible without releasing the preservation measure, and the debtor to perform its obligation without incurring enforcement costs or affecting its credit record, thereby meeting the interests of both parties and also being conducive to saving judicial resources. In practice, it is necessary to strengthen trial-execution coordination and be vigilant against potential circumstances that may harm the lawful rights and interests of other creditors.

First, adopting the preservation deduction measure before enforcement filing is conducive to fully realizing the systemic function of property preservation. The property preservation system ensures the protection of the creditor's litigation interests by restricting the preserved party's disposal of its property, with the core purpose of ensuring the performance of effective legal instruments. Article 106 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China provides that the methods of property preservation are "seizure, impoundment, freezing, or other methods prescribed by law," the effect of which is to achieve control over the preserved party's property, not disposal. Limited by the nature of preservation measures, in the past, even if the debtor was willing to voluntarily use the preserved property to repay the debt, only two measures could usually be taken: first, release the preservation measure and then have the debtor perform the corresponding obligation; second, after the judgment becomes effective, have the creditor apply to the people's court for compulsory enforcement. However, the former carries the risk of transferring property and evading performance, while the latter affects the timely realization of the obligee's interests and also causes damage to the debtor's credit. In fact, when the preserved party voluntarily performs and applies to the people's court to deduct the preserved funds, it is a disposition of the party's own rights, which is consistent with the purpose of the preservation system, conducive to promoting the automatic and timely performance of effective legal instruments, maximizing the protection of the lawful rights and interests of all parties, and also helpful in reducing enforcement cases at the source and saving enforcement costs. Therefore, before enforcement filing, if the preserved party applies to deduct preserved funds to fulfill obligations under an effective legal instrument, and the people's court, upon review, finds that there is no circumstance that may harm the lawful rights and interests of other creditors, it may grant the application and deduct the corresponding funds from the preserved party. If the debt is fully satisfied through the above procedure, the people's court may issue a certificate of automatic performance to the preserved party.

Second, when adopting the preservation deduction measure before enforcement filing, the court shall strictly review whether the party's application involves risks such as false litigation or preferential payment that may harm the lawful rights and interests of other creditors. When a party applies for a preservation deduction measure before enforcement filing, the court shall explain the legal consequences of maliciously harming other creditors' interests, such as through false litigation, and require the party to submit a letter of commitment. After accepting the party's application, the court shall actively search and verify whether the debtor is involved in other litigation or enforcement cases. If it is found that the debtor has other litigation or enforcement cases, the court shall, based on the specific circumstances of the case and without affecting the interests of other creditors, prudently decide whether to take the relevant preservation deduction measure.

Relevant Legal Provisions

Article 106 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China
